description: Filing Footnote event-filing categories. Each event filing gets exactly one category from this list by deterministic rules, or is excluded with a reason key. A filing that matches no rule is excluded and counted, never guessed. Superseded versions of corrected filings are dropped later in ingest, not here.

non_event_categories.note: The bundle's category for an annual report (DART 사업보고서, SEC 10-K). The classifier never assigns it; the M8 export sets it.

priority_note: When several rules of one SEC filing match, the category with the lowest priority number wins. A DART filing has one report name, so at most one rule applies.

excluded_reasons.rumor_response: Answer to a rumor, press report or exchange inquiry
excluded_reasons.forward_looking: Forward-looking plan or forecast; the product states no predictions
excluded_reasons.record_date: Record date or register closure notice
excluded_reasons.earnings_notice: Notice that results will be published later
excluded_reasons.bylaws_change: SEC Item 5.03 charter or bylaws amendment
excluded_reasons.exhibits_only: SEC Item 9.01 only: exhibits with no event item
excluded_reasons.rights_modification: SEC Item 3.03 change in security holder rights
excluded_reasons.no_keyword_match: SEC Item 7.01 or 8.01 text matched no keyword rule
excluded_reasons.trading_plan: SEC Item 7.01 or 8.01 notice of an insider Rule 10b5-1 trading plan
excluded_reasons.no_rule: Matches no rule and no explicit exclusion
excluded_reasons.needs_body: The decision needs the filing text and none was supplied

name_normalisation: Strip every leading bracketed group such as [기재정정] or [첨부추가] and record is_correction.
Remove a subsidiary marker, (종속회사의주요경영사항) or (자회사의주요경영사항), wherever it appears and record subsidiary.
Match on the name with all whitespace removed; names below are written that way.
dart.match_note: An entry matches when the normalised name starts with one of its prefixes. Exclusions are checked before rules. Within exclusions, and within rules, the longest matching prefix wins, whatever the list order.

earnings.plain_note: A plain name has no 연결재무제표기준 prefix, so its basis is separate. Whether it is a quarterly result or a monthly sales report comes from the reporting period in the body.
earnings.period_rule: The 당기실적 period must start on a first day and end on a month end. One month gives unit_sales only if the body reports no financial results, meaning the first 매출액 당해실적 cell is - or absent; a one-month body with a figure there is excluded as no_rule. Three or more months gives earnings. Anything else is excluded as no_rule.

rules.note: Overseas listing and DR issuance are filed with a new-share offering, so they sit with capital raises. Offering results, subscription results, issue price notices and an early buy-in of the company's own exchangeable bonds are capital events, not share buybacks.

sec.item_note: Item numbers are split on commas. A filing's category is the highest-priority category any of its items gives.

earnings_item.results_note: net income is not a results phrase: Tesla delivery releases only say that net income will be announced later.
earnings_item.rule: Item 2.02 is unit_sales when the text holds a production-and-deliveries phrase and no results phrase; otherwise earnings.

sec.form_note: The form is stripped and uppercased before use. A document whose type equals the form (8-K, 8-K/A) or is primary is the primary document.

keyword_sources.rationale: Keyword rules read the whole primary document and only the first 2000 characters of each EX-99.* exhibit, after HTML-to-text and SGML header removal. A deep presentation or press release mentions past repurchases, lawsuits and acquisitions in history and risk text that must not decide the category. Underwriting, indenture, opinion and contract exhibits (EX-1, EX-4, EX-5, EX-10 and others) are never read.

earnings_sources.rationale: The Item 2.02 rule needs to know whether a results marker appears anywhere in a release, so it reads the full primary document and full EX-99.* exhibits.

text_normalisation: Strip HTML tags and decode entities.
Map U+2010 to U+2015 and U+2212 to a plain hyphen.
sec.exclusion_order_note: When a filing has several exclusion reasons and no category, the reported reason is the first one in this list, whatever the item order. An item with no rule is reported first so a gap is not hidden behind a routine notice; the exhibits-only reason is the least informative.
sec.keyword_note: Lowercase phrases searched in the whitespace-collapsed, lowercased text of the primary document and exhibits. Item 7.01 or 8.01 with no phrase hit is excluded as the first matching no_keyword_reasons entry, else no_keyword_match.

phrases: entered into an agreement to acquire
